method: Evidence from the release files, compared with the reviewed 0.8.17; one Sonnet 5.5 agent established the facts with exact quotes; every quote checked against the release files and README by script; the facts that set the level checked again by hand; level from the fixed rule; label and summary written by Claude Opus 5.5.
label: Downloads and runs its Web Agent helper (3.3 MB) when you press Install Web Agent
summary: When you press Install, Repair or Upgrade in its Web account dialog, it downloads a 3.3 MB Web Agent zip from the developer's GitHub release, as the README says, and runs it with your own Node.js as a local helper that controls a browser.

facts.what: Downloads the Web Agent runtime zip (zai-web-agent-runtime.zip, 3,262,477 bytes: agent.mjs plus bundled node_modules/playwright-core) from the plugin's own GitHub release, unpacks it into the Zotero profile, and runs agent.mjs with the user's installed Node.js as a local companion process that drives a browser.
facts.readmeQuote: The plugin downloads the prebuilt runtime paired with the XPI and verifies its size and SHA-256
facts.notes: Only one download exists. The scanner's evidence (line 7344, fetchRuntimeArchive) is a fetch(url) helper whose only caller is repairWebAgentInstallation (6935, call at 6941), which passes release.downloadUrl from webAgentRuntimeRelease() (7396): hardcoded URL, size 3262477 and sha256 "7d06753a3d471599455abd55f657c3fe77df9e80f3c384a5acf001aafb594aeb". installWebAgentRuntimeArchive (6962) checks byteLength === release.size (6970), then SHA-256 of the bytes against release.sha256 (6976), and throws before unzipping/writing on mismatch. Checked against the maker's file: the v0.8.21 release asset zai-web-agent-runtime.zip downloaded from GitHub is 3,262,477 bytes with SHA-256 7d06753a...594aeb, and gh release view reports the same digest. Trigger: repairWebAgentInstallation is called only inside checkAndRepair(repairIfNeeded=true) (84452) in the WEB 'Account' dialog; that is invoked by the repair button click (84507; button label 'Install Web Agent' / 'Repair Web Agent') or by a manually chosen local ZIP (84520, installLocalWebAgentRuntime call at 84450, no download). The automatic calls checkAndRepair(false) (84242, 84534) only inspect and never download. After install, startWebAgent/launchWebAgent (lines 222-239) runs `exec(config2.nodePath, ...)` using the user's own Node.js (not downloaded). Source classification: the URL is in xuhan-rgb/zotero-ai-sidebar, the same repo as the plugin, so developer-own; the same author also builds the runtime zip, so the pinned hash only protects against tampering after release, not against the developer. Compared with 0.8.17 (reviewed): the same single download, same trigger, same size and SHA-256 check; only the URL tag (v0.8.17 -> v0.8.21), the pinned size and hash (3260862 / dccc008e... -> 3262477 / 7d06753a...), protocol version, and Firefox-snap/browser-profile handling in the install step changed. The README wording changed to 'The plugin downloads the prebuilt runtime paired with the XPI and verifies its size and SHA-256' (README line 83). The other fetch calls (lines 14066, 93175) are API requests, unchanged from 0.8.17.

alsoAppliesTo.how: Compared the Web Agent install code of 0.8.17 and 0.8.21 by hand: the same single download of the plugin's own release zip, the same click-only trigger, the same size and SHA-256 check before unpacking; only the version tag, pinned size and hash differ, and the new hash matches the maker's published zip.
